title: Corrupted newest recovery point
narrative: At 08:55 UTC the customer database volume is encrypted by ransomware. Before restoring, the recovery team re-runs integrity verification on the newest recovery point (08:00). It fails with checksum mismatches. RecoveryProof must find the newest point that is still eligible and recalculate the plan and data-loss exposure.

injections.description: Pre-restore integrity verification found checksum mismatches in 3 blocks.

recommended_actions: Restore from the newest verified earlier point
Quarantine the corrupted point and investigate possible tampering
Tell the business how much extra data was lost
